title: Lost Vape Ursa V3 Replacement Pods
description: The Lost Vape Ursa V3 Replacement Pods are designed for convenience and consistent performance, offering an easy and mess-free way to keep your Ursa device topped up with your favourite e-liquids. Available in three coil resistances (0.6ohm, 0.8ohm and 1.0ohm), these refillable pods cater to a range of vaping styles from MTL (mouth-to-lung) to RDL (restricted direct-to-lung). Each pod features a 2ml capacity with a side-fill design sealed by a silicone stopper for clean, leak-resistant refilling. The built-in coil design means no coil changes are needed—just replace the pod when performance begins to fade. A comfortable drip tip and adjustable airflow system allow you to fine-tune your draw for a tailored vape every time. Compatible with the Ursa Pocket Kit and all Ursa Nano Pod Kits, these pods work best with 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquids depending on the coil resistance selected. Lost Vape Ursa V2 0.6ohm RDL - We recommend paring this pod with 50/50,Nic Salt, or high PG E-Liquid Lost Vape Ursa V2 0.8ohm MTL - We Recommend paring this pod with 50/50, Nic Salt or high PG E-Liquid Lost Vape Ursa V2 1.0ohm MTL - We Recommend paring this pod with 50/50 or high PG E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
